approvalMessage.text:
APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 50 Chapter 729
 
       MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 7919, entitled:
 
    "AN  ACT  to amend the state finance law, the general municipal law,
        the public authorities law and the highway law, in  relation  to
        enacting the New York state buy American salt act"
 
    APPROVED
 
  This  bill  would  amend several provisions of law which would mandate
that  the  State,  localities,  and  other  contracting  authorities  be
required to procure American produced rock salt and sodium chloride.
 
  This legislation required several amendments before it could be signed
into  law in order to achieve the goals of the legislation while keeping
costs down for New  Yorkers.  The  changes  ensure  that  a  contracting
authority would have the ability to bypass procurement law for a produc-
er  of rock salt or sodium chloride if their bid falls within 10 percent
of the lowest bidder. These  changes  will  enable  those  who  wish  to
contract to buy American salt to have the flexibility to do so.
 
  Based on this agreement, I am pleased to sign this bill into law.
 
  This bill is approved.                         (signed) KATHY HOCHUL
 
                                ______

summary: Enacts the New York state buy American salt act to ensure all rock salt, or sodium chloride, used or supplied in the performance of a government contract or any subcontract thereto within the state shall be mined or hand harvested in the United States.
title: Relates to enacting the New York state buy American salt act
